gloss: to raise (to adulthood); to bring up; to train fully

definitions.gloss: to raise (to adulthood); to bring up; to train fully
definitions.explanation: To raise a child until they are grown, or to train a person, a team or a business until it is fully developed; stresses the effort and the finished result.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{育|そだ}て{上|あ}げる。
examples.english: To raise a child to adulthood.
My mother brought up three children on her own.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{小|ちい}さな→小さな：02913_chiisana⟧⟦{町工場|まちこうば}→町工場：26008_machikouba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{三十年|さんじゅうねん}かけて⟦{世界的|せかいてき}→世界的：20935_sekaiteki⟧な⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{育|そだ}て{上|あ}げた。
examples.english: Over thirty years he built a small local workshop into a world-class company.

notes:
⟦{育|そだ}てる→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧ (to raise) + ⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧ (to completion). Unlike plain ⟦{育|そだ}てる→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧, it looks back on a job seen through to the end, so it usually appears in the past tense.

TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive: the person or thing raised takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧; what it becomes takes ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {女手一|おんなでひと}つ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{育|そだ}て{上|あ}げる: to raise (children) as a single mother
- ⟦{一流|いちりゅう}→一流：03009_ichiryuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{育|そだ}て{上|あ}げる: to train into a top athlete
- ⟦{立派|りっぱ}→立派：01093_rippa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{育|そだ}て{上|あ}げる: to bring up well
